authorization: 用户：可以用多种验证因子有效性的方式去验证哈
scope: 原三个因子/原三ETF/原20间隔MAE/原两个后续评价期，不改变原合同；保存预测的辅助分析

rank.formula: within each asset and fold, Pearson correlation of average ranks of X and Y (Spearman); report each cell and equal-ETF fold aggregation, training direction from earlier mature rows only
rank.reason: 不依赖原线性预测形状，检查大小顺序；关联不是增量

groups.thresholds: per asset/fold train feature30th and70th percentiles, linear quantile; eval low<=q30, high>q70, middle otherwise
groups.outputs: group mean and median MAE; equal-ETF high-low mean; high/low coverage; unconditioned relationship only
groups.direction: raw high minus low, do not flip according to evaluation results

conditional_groups.background: per asset/fold training medians of volatility20 and return20 create four cells; candidate q30/q70 computed only on training cell; train minimum20; eval each extreme minimum5
conditional_groups.weights: within asset eligible cell weights proportional to all evaluation rows (including middle), normalized across supported cells; fixed three assets equal; missing asset -> overall unestimated
conditional_groups.scope: descriptive comparable-background contrast; different dates; only two background variables controlled, not full baseline increment

nonoverlap.clock: full frozen trading calendar index modulo21, all21 phases, same phase dates and full3assets per fold; no choose best phase
nonoverlap.metric: saved B1/B2 MSE relative change, pooled twofold equalassets; offsets21 intervals, adjacent future windows share boundary close but no return interval overlap
nonoverlap.reason: reduce repeated overlapping future outcomes; small phase samples and dependent phase alternatives not independent replications

multiple_candidates.periods: each original fold evaluated complete contiguous support first..last saved dates
multiple_candidates.scope: same-unit maximum loss improvement jointly resampled, only current3 candidate family, not all historical attempts; period selection solely complete support;2026 few blocks limitations
multiple_candidates.strong_simple: compare-losses on same saved support with frozen per-ETF training mature target average as benchmark; source/values independently verified

dependence.axis: each full fold evaluation calendar separately; resample folds separately, ETF same draw; no acrossfold circular connection
dependence.missing_groups: unestimable draws reported, never set0; group highlow interval requires all3ETF present

conclusion_rule: No pass count vote or new threshold. Seek consistency, useful magnitude, simple baseline superiority, robust uncertainty; negative/inconclusive finish. Original B1->B2 remains primary increment; supplementary association cannot override it.
protected: all previous frozen outputs and research-source/production rules unchanged
